This is ACTUAL game asset art. Restrained brushwork, readable silhouette, soft neutral diffuse light. No text, labels, letters, numbers, borders, grid lines, banners, heraldry, Gothic spires, domes, moon, magical ring or predicted path. No baked lighting, glare, bloom, ground shadows, or gold/amber glowing details. Gold is rendered by the game; leave lenses and screens unlit. ONE opaque environmental panorama atlas with EXACTLY 3 equal columns and 2 equal rows, every cell a separate complete 2:1 wide panorama. No margins or borders. Atmospheric far-background city/industrial silhouettes in muted teal/violet blue hour, not a playable foreground. No people, rings, gold lights, path tiles, moon, domes, spires or writing. Small human windows can be faint neutral cream, sky and water mostly dark. Row-major cells: 1: dense old archival quarter, burgundy brick Art Nouveau civic buildings and tiny muted magenta/lime old neon; 2: foggy seawall pumping station, low concrete piers and tidal turbines; 3: fishing boat-houses, timber pilings and hand-wired harbor masts, cold teal and faint cyan human lanterns, NO gold; 4: two tall black-glass towers and precise civic architecture, NO golden veins or ring; 5: low circular emergency platform in the estuary with civic shelters and far black-glass city, NO moon or gold lights; 6: rainy Meridian estuary with layered 1900s civic roofs and distant black-glass towers, dense ornate city, quiet dark water. Request high resolution, each panorama wide and softly painted for parallax.

sheets.name: ground_details
sheets.prompt: Generate a new runtime terrain material atlas for Undertow matching the paint, patina and muted teal-grey color of the reference materials. EXACTLY three columns and two rows, SIX equal full bleed rectangular material panels without gutters, text, borders or labels. Square detail features within each panel. Orthographic top down surfaces, no perspective, no objects, no highlights, no bloom or baked shadows. Hand-painted readable strokes and wet aged surfaces, NOT procedural graphics. Row-major: top left rain-wet old stone stair treads, 4 distinct parallel wide worn stone steps across the panel, subtle beveled edges; top center scuffed dark grey-green hospital linoleum with small worn cream inset squares; top right rain-wet dark near-black asphalt with fine pebbled aggregate; bottom left old quay large weathered grey flagstone slabs with irregular joints and damp moss; bottom center civic concrete foundation panels with expansion joints, hairline cracks and aggregate; bottom right weather-stained seawall concrete with tide stains and thin green algae along joints. No wood grain in any panel. The six textures must read distinctly at 128px tile scale. Every panel fills its bounds and may repeat across a game floor.

sheets.name: city_map_v2
sheets.prompt: Create a painted in-game navigation map background for Undertow's Meridian. Reference images guide ONLY architecture and hand-painted rainy teal-violet port-city materials. REMOVE all ring emblems, predicted paths, people, writing and foreground poster composition from the references. Landscape 16:9 high oblique aerial map, flat graphic readability, a dense 1900s INDUSTRIAL port in a river delta with modest Art Nouveau ironwork, dark brick and slate roofs, black-glass municipal skyscrapers and elevated rail. No fantasy, no palaces, no castles, no churches, no domes, no Gothic spires, no crenellations, no marble fortresses. Plain roofs, taller flat-topped rectangular industrial buildings, tiny boats and cranes. No text, labels, markers, symbols, luminous dots, gold ring, border, moon or sky; the map fills the image with terrain and dark teal water. Place district centers at these normalized image positions (x across,y down), leaving them visible for UI labels added by code: Kestrel Heights leafy hillside old stone terraces (0.27,0.20); The Loop rail interchange (0.64,0.16); Tideworks rusted container docks and gantry cranes (0.84,0.48); Mercy General long grey-white hospital campus (0.18,0.50); Vellum compact dark brick newspaper and archive blocks (0.36,0.66); Greywater concrete seawalls and pumping works (0.56,0.80); Harbor Ward small tarred timber boathouses on separate wooden piers, low roofs, boats, severed bridge, outside the rail network (0.84,0.78); The Spire cluster of tall BLACK GLASS RECTANGULAR towers (0.50,0.45), not a circular palace. The Ark at (0.70,0.94), a small flat circular civic concrete emergency platform with modest low brick/slate workshops on it, surrounded by the estuary. Elevated rail forms an ellipse across districts around center(.5,.45), radii(.33,.33), but never Harbor Ward. Grey-water river channels and island connections support that route. Muted moody blue hour, soft neutral diffuse light; no glowing amber hardware, no dramatic sunset. Real working port neighborhoods, painted material detail, flat-topped civil buildings.

sheets.name: council_v2
sheets.prompt: Create ONE isolated transparent runtime game sprite for Undertow: a SUNKEN circular council chamber foundation on the Ark. Match the worn grey stone and carved verdigris Art Nouveau concrete palette of the reference prop sheet. Only use the reference for materials: do NOT reproduce its raised dais. The camera is fixed isometric, looking down at 30 degrees, circular ground projects as a wide ellipse approximately 1.8:1. A low circular stone curb lies flat at ground level; three concentric steps DESCEND INWARD into a recessed dark circular floor, like an empty small amphitheatre or circular drain inspection chamber. The middle floor is visibly BELOW the outer rim, never a raised platform or ascending stairs. A single small access notch at front. Fully open, low enough to see across. No doors or standing frames (runtime adds the three doors), no wall over knee height, no raised central plinth, no buildings, no people, no furniture, no ring glyph, no light, no shadows outside silhouette, no gold, no moon, no text or border. Hand-painted old civic stone, subdued teal-grey shadows, worn stair edges, cracks and damp patina. Entire prop uncropped and centered with generous transparent margins. True RGBA transparency outside the entire silhouette.
